name: Watt & Watt Marching Cubes
definition: An improved version of the Marching Cubes algorithm that treats arbitrary datasets and isosurfaces efficiently, addressing issues of I/O and cell classification timing.
summary: Watt & Watt Marching Cubes is an optimized volume rendering algorithm that resolves topological inconsistencies and reduces redundant computation through a modified lookup table and vertex deduplication.
